sloka: दश आस्यो विंशति भुजो बभूव क्षणदा चरः ।स परिव्राजक च्छद्म महाकायो विहाय तत् ॥३-४९-८॥
transliteration: daśa āsyo viṁśati bhujo babhūva kṣaṇadā caraḥ ।sa parivrājaka cchadma mahākāyo vihāya tat ॥3-49-8॥

translations.english: Ravana, chief of the demons, shed the mendicant's form and assumed his real self. Clad in red garments, his eyes turned red in anger. Looking like layers of clouds, he stood in front of Sita, a gem among women.
